Name: Lore_FirstDawn
Title: The First Dawn
Body: Before the four regions had names, the First Dawn left a living signal inside the earth. The Echoes are responses to that signal, not servants of it.

Name: Lore_AstraResonator
Title: The Resonator
Body: An Astra Resonator does not dominate an Echo. It creates a brief agreement between two living patterns, and the trust that follows depends on how the agreement was made.

Name: Lore_DangerPit
Title: The Sunken Pit
Body: The South-East basin is where the Dawn signal became unstable. Alpha Echoes gather there because the pressure makes their elemental memory louder.

Name: Lore_ThreeEchoes
Title: Three Ways to Belong
Body: Pyrelite follows the horizon, Thornback holds the line, and Aquavine keeps a camp alive. Their roles are different, but none is lesser.
